attributes.sdk_abi_witness: include/dolphin/gx/GXTexture.h declares GXInitTlutRegion(GXTlutRegion*,u32,GXTlutSize); GXStruct.h defines the region as u32 dummy[4], and GXEnum.h gives GX_TLUT_16=1 / GX_TLUT_256=16. The existing local prototype uses void*,u32,u32, but caller and target both supply the region address, TMEM address and size in r3/r4/r5 respectively. The matched 18/18 SDK GXInitTlutRegion target consumes r3 at +0x4 stw r0,0(r3), r4 at +0x8 addis r0,r4,-8, and r5 at +0x14 slwi r0,r5,10. Thus the narrower enum/pointer declaration discrepancy does not misplace or omit an argument here. Command: python tools/gdl/fnasm.py dolphin/gx/GXTexture GXInitTlutRegion --diff.
